WITH lf AS (
  SELECT s.school, s.doctype,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS diff
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
  WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT school, doctype
FROM lf
WHERE diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) FROM lf)

), names AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['Stacy','Avetik']) AS nm)

GROUP BY d.district, names.nm ORDER BY d.district, names.nm;

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.cdscode, f."County Name" AS county, f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter,
         ROUND((f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" * 100)::numeric, 2) AS free_pct,
         ROUND((f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" * 100)::numeric, 2) AS frpm_pct
  FROM frpm f
  WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
), sat AS (
  SELECT s.cds, (s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite) AS total
  FROM satscores s WHERE s.avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND s.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL AND s.avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT b.county,
  COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(b.free_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(b.frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.charter = 1) AS charter_schools,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.charter = 0) AS non_charter_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) AS avg_sat_total
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN sat t ON t.cds = b.cdscode
GROUP BY b.county

         ROUND((f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" * 100)::numeric, 2) AS free_pct,
         ROUND((f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" * 100)::numeric, 2) AS frpm_pct
  FROM frpm f
  WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
), sat AS (
  SELECT s.cds, (s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite) AS total
  FROM satscores s WHERE s.avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND s.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL AND s.avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT b.county,
  COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(b.free_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(b.frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.charter = 1) AS charter_schools,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.charter = 0) AS non_charter_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) AS avg_sat_total
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN sat t ON t.cds = b.cdscode
GROUP BY b.county

SELECT s.school, s.charter, s.gsserved, f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS rate, sat.avgscrread, sat.avgscrmath, sat.avgscrwrite

FROM t WHERE rate = (SELECT MAX(rate) FROM t)

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.cdscode, f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm, f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS share
  FROM frpm f
  WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100 AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
),
parts AS (
  SELECT 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, cdscode FROM base WHERE frpm = (SELECT max(frpm) FROM base)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'smallest FRPM share', cdscode FROM base WHERE share = (SELECT min(share) FROM base)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'the CDS code from my notes', cdscode FROM schools WHERE cdscode = '04615150435602'
)
SELECT p.part,
       s.school AS school_name,
       s.county,
       s.city,
       s.mailstreet,
       s.mailcity,
       s.mailstate,
       s.mailzip,
       s.website,
       f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
       f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
       f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS frpm_share,
       sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite AS avg_total_sat,
       100.0 * sat.numge1500 / NULLIF(sat.numtsttakr, 0) AS pct_sat_1500_plus,
       s.opendate,
       CASE WHEN s.closeddate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status
FROM parts p
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = p.cdscode
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = p.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = p.cdscode

WITH q AS (
  SELECT owneruserid AS userid
  FROM posts
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creaiondate) = 2012 AND owneruserid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY owneruserid
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
),
up AS (
  SELECT q.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS upvotes
  FROM q
  LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.userid = q.userid AND v.votetypeid = 2
  GROUP BY q.userid
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(up.upvotes)::numeric, 2) AS avg_upvotes,
       ROUND(AVG(u.age)::numeric, 2) AS avg_age
FROM up

),

  FROM team t JOIN risky r ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id

  SELECT ta.team_api_id, ta.chancecreationpassing,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.date DESC) AS rn

),

  SELECT team_api_id, chancecreationpassing FROM latest WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT rt.team_short_name AS short_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rt.team_api_id) AS club_count,
       ROUND(AVG(cur.chancecreationpassing)::numeric, 1) AS avg_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM rt
LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.team_api_id = rt.team_api_id

  SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id
  FROM match m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3

  GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
)
SELECT team_long_name, team_short_name, wins
FROM counts
WHERE wins = (SELECT MAX(wins) FROM counts)

)

FROM pops
WHERE population = (SELECT MAX(population) FROM pops)

WITH acc_bal AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000
),
gold AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dp.account_id, cl.gender
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
  JOIN disp own ON own.account_id = dp.account_id AND own.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = own.client_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT g.gender, ds.district_id, ds.a2, ds.a4::bigint AS inh, ds.a10, ds.a11
  FROM gold g
  JOIN acc_bal b ON b.account_id = g.account_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
  JOIN district ds ON ds.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE ds.a4::bigint > 100000
),
r AS (
  SELECT x.*,
         COUNT(*) OVER w AS cnt,
         AVG(x.a11) OVER w AS avg_sal,
         AVG(x.a10) OVER w AS avg_urb,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY x.gender ORDER BY x.inh DESC) AS rk
  FROM d x
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY x.gender)
)
SELECT gender,
       cnt AS district_count,
       a2 AS top_district,
       inh AS top_inhabitants,
       ROUND(avg_sal::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary,
       ROUND(avg_urb::numeric, 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
FROM r
WHERE rk = 1
ORDER BY gender DESC, a2

WITH acc_bal AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000
),
gold AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dp.account_id, cl.gender
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
  JOIN disp own ON own.account_id = dp.account_id AND own.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = own.client_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT g.gender, ds.district_id, ds.a2, ds.a4::bigint AS inh, ds.a10, ds.a11
  FROM gold g
  JOIN acc_bal b ON b.account_id = g.account_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
  JOIN district ds ON ds.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE ds.a4::bigint > 100000
),
r AS (
  SELECT x.*,
         COUNT(*) OVER w AS cnt,
         AVG(x.a11) OVER w AS avg_sal,
         AVG(x.a10) OVER w AS avg_urb,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY x.gender ORDER BY x.inh DESC) AS rk
  FROM d x
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY x.gender)
)
SELECT gender,
       cnt AS district_count,
       a2 AS top_district,
       inh AS top_inhabitants,
       ROUND(avg_sal::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary,
       ROUND(avg_urb::numeric, 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
FROM r
WHERE rk = 1
ORDER BY gender DESC, a2

WITH acc AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  WHERE a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE a2 = 'Prachatice')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id)
),
owner AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, c.district_id AS home_district
  FROM disp d JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
ld AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_borrowed FROM loan GROUP BY account_id),
cp AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS counterparties
  FROM trans
  WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET','PREVOD Z UCTU') AND account IS NOT NULL AND account <> 0
  GROUP BY account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT acc.account_id, acc.opened, ld.total_borrowed, COALESCE(cp.counterparties,0) AS counterparties,
         o.home_district, di.a4::bigint AS population
  FROM acc
  JOIN ld ON ld.account_id = acc.account_id
  LEFT JOIN cp ON cp.account_id = acc.account_id
  LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = acc.account_id
  LEFT JOIN district di ON di.district_id = o.home_district
)
SELECT account_id, opened, total_borrowed, counterparties, home_district, population,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY population DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk
FROM base
ORDER BY population DESC NULLS LAST, account_id ASC

WITH acc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.date AS open_date, a.frequency, a.district_id AS acc_district
  FROM disp dp JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
  WHERE dp.client_id = 3541
),
dist AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4::bigint AS pop, d.a11
  FROM district d
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT a3,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM client c JOIN district dc ON dc.district_id = c.district_id WHERE dc.a3 = x.a3) AS client_cnt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a3 FROM district) x
),
top_dist AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (a3) a3, a2 AS top_name, pop AS top_pop
  FROM dist
  ORDER BY a3, pop DESC, district_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT district_id, a3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY pop DESC) AS pop_rank
  FROM dist
),
tx AS (
  SELECT account_id,
    count(*) AS ntrans,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END), 0) AS income,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount END), 0) AS expense
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM acc)
  GROUP BY account_id
),
ln AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (account_id) account_id, status, amount
  FROM loan
  WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM acc)
  ORDER BY account_id, date DESC
)
SELECT
  acc.account_id,
  acc.open_date,
  acc.frequency,
  dd.a2 AS district_name,
  dd.a3 AS region,
  CASE WHEN acc.acc_district = cl.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
  dd.a11 AS avg_salary,
  COALESCE(ln.status, 'none') AS loan_status,
  COALESCE(ln.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
  COALESCE(tx.ntrans, 0) AS num_transactions,
  COALESCE(tx.income, 0) AS total_income,
  COALESCE(tx.expense, 0) AS total_expense,
  COALESCE(tx.income, 0) - COALESCE(tx.expense, 0) AS net_balance,
  rs.client_cnt AS region_client_count,
  td.top_name AS most_populous_district,
  td.top_pop AS most_populous_pop,
  rk.pop_rank AS population_rank_in_region
FROM acc
JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = 3541
JOIN dist dd ON dd.district_id = acc.acc_district
JOIN region_stats rs ON rs.a3 = dd.a3
JOIN top_dist td ON td.a3 = dd.a3
JOIN ranked rk ON rk.district_id = dd.district_id
LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.account_id = acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.account_id = acc.account_id
ORDER BY num_transactions DESC, acc.account_id ASC;

WITH acc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.date AS open_date, a.frequency, a.district_id AS acc_district
  FROM disp dp JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
  WHERE dp.client_id = 3541
),
dist AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3, d.a4::bigint AS pop, d.a11
  FROM district d
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT a3,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM client c JOIN district dc ON dc.district_id = c.district_id WHERE dc.a3 = x.a3) AS client_cnt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a3 FROM district) x
),
top_dist AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (a3) a3, a2 AS top_name, pop AS top_pop
  FROM dist
  ORDER BY a3, pop DESC, district_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT district_id, a3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY pop DESC) AS pop_rank
  FROM dist
),
tx AS (
  SELECT account_id,
    count(*) AS ntrans,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END), 0) AS income,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount END), 0) AS expense
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM acc)
  GROUP BY account_id
),
ln AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (account_id) account_id, status, amount
  FROM loan
  WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM acc)
  ORDER BY account_id, date DESC
)
SELECT
  acc.account_id,
  acc.open_date,
  acc.frequency,
  dd.a2 AS district_name,
  dd.a3 AS region,
  CASE WHEN acc.acc_district = cl.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
  dd.a11 AS avg_salary,
  COALESCE(ln.status, 'none') AS loan_status,
  COALESCE(ln.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
  COALESCE(tx.ntrans, 0) AS num_transactions,
  COALESCE(tx.income, 0) AS total_income,
  COALESCE(tx.expense, 0) AS total_expense,
  COALESCE(tx.income, 0) - COALESCE(tx.expense, 0) AS net_balance,
  rs.client_cnt AS region_client_count,
  td.top_name AS most_populous_district,
  td.top_pop AS most_populous_pop,
  rk.pop_rank AS population_rank_in_region
FROM acc
JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = 3541
JOIN dist dd ON dd.district_id = acc.acc_district
JOIN region_stats rs ON rs.a3 = dd.a3
JOIN top_dist td ON td.a3 = dd.a3
JOIN ranked rk ON rk.district_id = dd.district_id
LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.account_id = acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.account_id = acc.account_id
ORDER BY num_transactions DESC, acc.account_id ASC;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT district_id, a2, a3, a4::bigint AS pop
  FROM district
  WHERE a4 ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND a4::bigint >= 100000
),
w AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
s AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount::numeric) AS sipo_total
  FROM "order" o
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
acc AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS n_accounts
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT d.a2 AS district_name,
         d.a3 AS region,
         d.pop AS population,
         w.total_withdrawn,
         ROUND(w.total_withdrawn::numeric / d.pop, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
         ROUND(COALESCE(s.sipo_total, 0) / acc.n_accounts, 2) AS avg_standing_order_per_account
  FROM d
  JOIN w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN acc ON acc.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN s ON s.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT district_name,
       region,
       population,
       total_withdrawn,
       withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawal_rank,
       avg_standing_order_per_account
FROM base
ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC, district_name

WITH cards94 AS (
  SELECT c.card_id, c.type AS card_type, c.issued, d.client_id, d.account_id
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND c.issued < DATE '1995-01-01'
),
loan_agg AS (
  SELECT account_id, count(*) AS loan_count, sum(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT cl.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date, x.card_type,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM x.issued)::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cl.birth_date)::int AS age_at_issue,
         COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
         COALESCE(la.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
         di.a2 AS district_name, di.a11 AS avg_salary
  FROM cards94 x
  JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = x.client_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_agg la ON la.account_id = x.account_id
  LEFT JOIN district di ON di.district_id = cl.district_id
)
SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, loan_count, total_amount,
       CASE
         WHEN loan_count > 0 AND age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
         WHEN loan_count > 0 AND age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
         ELSE 'Non-borrower'
       END AS borrower_classification,
       district_name, avg_salary,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM base
ORDER BY client_id;

WITH fem_loans AS (
  SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, d.client_id, c.birth_date, a.district_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
top_loans AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT f.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f.amount DESC) AS rk FROM fem_loans f
  ) x WHERE rk <= 3
),
region_loans AS (
  SELECT di.a3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS loan_cnt
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY di.a3
),
region_salary AS (
  SELECT a3 AS region, ROUND(AVG(a11)::numeric, 2) AS region_avg_salary
  FROM (
    SELECT a3, AVG(a11) AS a11 FROM district GROUP BY a3, district_id
  ) s
  GROUP BY a3
)
SELECT
  t.client_id,
  ROUND(t.amount::numeric, 2) AS loan_amount,
  t.duration AS duration_months,
  ROUND((t.payments * t.duration)::numeric, 2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND((t.payments * t.duration - t.amount)::numeric, 2) AS interest_paid,
  t.status AS loan_status,
  di.a2 AS district,
  di.a3 AS region,
  COALESCE(tx.tx_cnt, 0) AS transaction_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(tx.deposits, 0)::numeric, 2) AS total_deposits,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(tx.deposits, 0) > 2 * t.amount THEN 'High Income'
    WHEN COALESCE(tx.deposits, 0) > t.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
    ELSE 'Low Income'
  END AS income_category,
  rl.loan_cnt AS loans_in_region,
  rs.region_avg_salary,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', t.birth_date))::int
    - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.birth_date), EXTRACT(DAY FROM t.birth_date)) > (10, 9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS client_age
FROM top_loans t
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = t.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS tx_cnt,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposits
  FROM trans GROUP BY account_id
) tx ON tx.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_loans rl ON rl.region = di.a3
LEFT JOIN region_salary rs ON rs.region = di.a3
ORDER BY t.amount DESC

WITH gold AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.account_id
  FROM card c JOIN disp p ON p.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
tr AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> '' AND t.account IS NOT NULL AND t.account <> 0
                             THEN t.bank || '/' || t.account END) AS ext_counterparties
  FROM trans t
  JOIN gold g ON g.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ln AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
  FROM loan l
  JOIN gold g ON g.account_id = l.account_id
  GROUP BY l.account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region,
         COALESCE(tr.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
         COALESCE(tr.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
         COALESCE(ln.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
         COALESCE(tr.ext_counterparties, 0) AS ext_counterparties
  FROM gold g
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  LEFT JOIN tr ON tr.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.account_id = g.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_received, total_withdrawn, loan_count, ext_counterparties,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ext_counterparties DESC) AS rank
FROM base
ORDER BY rank, account_id;

sql:
WITH owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.type = 'classic'
),
clients_per_dist AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.client_id) AS num_clients
  FROM owners o
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
out_tx AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, t.bank, t.account, t.amount
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM owners)
),
pay_per_dist AS (
  SELECT a.district_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT (ot.bank, ot.account)) FILTER (WHERE ot.bank IS NOT NULL) AS num_ext,
         SUM(ot.amount) AS total_amt
  FROM out_tx ot
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ot.account_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id
)
SELECT di.a2 AS district_name,
       COALESCE(cp.num_clients, 0) AS num_clients,
       COALESCE(pp.num_ext, 0) AS num_external_accounts,
       COALESCE(pp.total_amt, 0) AS total_amount
FROM district di
LEFT JOIN clients_per_dist cp ON cp.district_id = di.district_id
LEFT JOIN pay_per_dist pp ON pp.district_id = di.district_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC

WITH acc AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened, a.district_id
  FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE d.a2 = 'Tabor' AND a.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
),
owner AS (
  SELECT dp.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
  FROM disp dp JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER'
),
cards AS (
  SELECT dp.account_id, count(*) AS n_cards
  FROM card cd JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
  WHERE cd.issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY dp.account_id
),
loans AS (
  SELECT account_id, count(*) AS n_loans,
    bool_or(status = 'B') AS has_b,
    bool_or(status IN ('C','D')) AS has_cd
  FROM loan
  WHERE date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
tx AS (
  SELECT account_id,
    count(*) AS n_tx,
    COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END), 0) AS money_in,
    COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ','VYBER') THEN amount END), 0) AS money_out,
    max(balance) AS peak
  FROM trans
  WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date <= DATE '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
prof AS (
  SELECT acc.account_id, acc.opened, o.gender,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '1996-12-31', o.birth_date))::int AS age,
    COALESCE(cards.n_cards, 0) AS n_cards,
    COALESCE(loans.n_loans, 0) AS n_loans,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(loans.n_loans,0) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
         WHEN loans.has_b THEN 'defaulted'
         WHEN loans.has_cd THEN 'repaying'
         ELSE 'paid off' END AS loan_label,
    COALESCE(tx.n_tx, 0) AS n_tx,
    COALESCE(tx.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
    COALESCE(tx.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
    COALESCE(tx.peak, 0) AS peak
  FROM acc
  LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = acc.account_id
  LEFT JOIN cards ON cards.account_id = acc.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loans ON loans.account_id = acc.account_id
  LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.account_id = acc.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, opened, gender, age, n_cards, n_loans, loan_label, n_tx, money_in, money_out, peak,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak DESC) AS peak_rank
FROM prof
ORDER BY peak_rank, account_id

WITH fl AS (
  SELECT l.raceid, l.driverid, min(l.milliseconds) AS ms
  FROM laptimes l
  JOIN races r ON r.raceid = l.raceid
  WHERE r.name = 'French Grand Prix' AND r.year >= 1990
  GROUP BY l.raceid, l.driverid
)
SELECT r.date,
       d.forename,
       d.surname,
       (fl.ms / 60000)::text || ':' || lpad(((fl.ms % 60000) / 1000)::text, 2, '0') || '.' || lpad((fl.ms % 1000)::text, 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM races r
LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.raceid = r.raceid AND fl.ms > 90000
LEFT JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = fl.driverid
WHERE r.name = 'French Grand Prix' AND r.year >= 1990
ORDER BY r.date, d.surname, d.forename

FROM results r WHERE r.raceid = 1 OR r.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM results WHERE rank = 2 LIMIT 2) ORDER BY r.raceid, r.rank LIMIT 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rank=2) AS r2, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rank IS NULL) AS rnull, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rank=0) AS r0, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fastestlaptime IS NULL OR fastestlaptime='' OR fastestlaptime='\N') AS ftnull, COUNT(*) AS n FROM results;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT raceid, driverid, rank,
    split_part(fastestlaptime,':',1)::int*60000 + round(split_part(fastestlaptime,':',2)::numeric*1000) AS ms
  FROM results WHERE fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND fastestlaptime<>'' AND fastestlaptime<>'\N'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT raceid FROM t GROUP BY raceid HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rank=2)>1) x) AS dup_rank2_races,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT raceid FROM t GROUP BY raceid, ms HAVING COUNT(*)>1) y) AS tied_time_groups,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE rank=2) AS r2_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT raceid FROM t GROUP BY raceid HAVING MIN(ms)=MIN(ms)) z) AS races;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT raceid, driverid,
    split_part(fastestlaptime,':',1)::int*60000 + round(split_part(fastestlaptime,':',2)::numeric*1000) AS ms
  FROM results WHERE fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND fastestlaptime<>'' AND fastestlaptime<>'\N'
), best AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(ms) ms FROM t GROUP BY raceid, driverid),
ranked AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, ms, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY ms) dr FROM best),
second AS (SELECT DISTINCT raceid, driverid FROM ranked WHERE dr=2),
r2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT raceid, driverid FROM results WHERE rank=2)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM second) s_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r2) r2_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM second EXCEPT SELECT * FROM r2) q) diff1,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) FROM drivers d JOIN second s ON s.driverid=d.driverid WHERE d.dob >= '1976-01-01') time_based,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) FROM drivers d JOIN r2 s ON s.driverid=d.driverid WHERE d.dob >= '1976-01-01') rank_based;

('red_bull_ring','Europe/Vienna'),('BAK','Asia/Baku'),('bahrain','Asia/Bahrain'),('spa','Europe/Brussels'),
('interlagos','America/Sao_Paulo'),('villeneuve','America/Montreal'),('shanghai','Asia/Shanghai'),('magny_cours','Europe/Paris'),
('hockenheimring','Europe/Berlin'),('nurburgring','Europe/Berlin'),('hungaroring','Europe/Budapest'),('buddh','Asia/Kolkata'),
('imola','Europe/Rome'),('monza','Europe/Rome'),('fuji','Asia/Tokyo'),('suzuka','Asia/Tokyo'),('yeongam','Asia/Seoul'),
('sepang','Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'),('rodriguez','America/Mexico_City'),('monaco','Europe/Monaco'),('sochi','Europe/Moscow'),
('marina_bay','Asia/Singapore'),('catalunya','Europe/Madrid'),('valencia','Europe/Madrid'),('istanbul','Europe/Istanbul'),
('yas_marina','Asia/Dubai'),('silverstone','Europe/London'),('americas','America/Chicago'),('indianapolis','America/New_York')),
loc AS (
 SELECT c.circuitref, ((r.date + r.time::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE m.tz)::time AS local_start
 FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitid=r.circuitid JOIN tzmap m ON m.circuitref=c.circuitref
 WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL),
mm AS (SELECT min(local_start) AS mn, max(local_start) AS mx FROM loc)
SELECT
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT l.circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY l.circuitref) FROM loc l, mm WHERE l.local_start = mm.mn) AS earliest_circuitref,
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT l.circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY l.circuitref) FROM loc l, mm WHERE l.local_start = mm.mx) AS latest_circuitref,
 EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (mm.mx - mm.mn))::bigint AS gap_seconds
FROM mm

WITH grp AS (
  SELECT m.member_id,
         CASE WHEN m.position IN ('President','Vice President','Secretary','Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other' END AS grp
  FROM member m
),
per_member AS (
  SELECT g.member_id, g.grp, COUNT(a.link_to_event) AS events_attended
  FROM grp g
  LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member = g.member_id
  GROUP BY g.member_id, g.grp
)
SELECT grp,
       ROUND(AVG(events_attended)::numeric, 2) AS avg_events_attended
FROM per_member
GROUP BY grp
ORDER BY grp;

WITH att AS (
  SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendees
  FROM attendance
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
water AS (
  SELECT b.link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(e.cost) AS water_cost
  FROM expense e
  JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  WHERE lower(e.expense_description) LIKE '%water%'
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT ev.event_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(w.water_cost, 0)::numeric / a.attendees, 2) AS water_cost_per_attendee
FROM event ev
JOIN att a ON a.event_id = ev.event_id
LEFT JOIN water w ON w.event_id = ev.event_id
ORDER BY ev.event_name, ev.event_id

WITH x AS (
  SELECT e.link_to_member, lower(trim(u)) AS item
  FROM expense e, unnest(string_to_array(e.expense_description, ',')) AS u
  WHERE e.expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND e.expense_date < '2019-12-01'
),
c AS (SELECT link_to_member, count(DISTINCT item) AS kinds FROM x GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT link_to_member, sum(cost) AS spent FROM expense
      WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, c.kinds, s.spent
FROM c JOIN s ON s.link_to_member = c.link_to_member
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = c.link_to_member
WHERE c.kinds = (SELECT max(kinds) FROM c)
ORDER BY full_name

WITH dc_powers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN superhero s ON s.id = hp.hero_id
  JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
),
marvel_heroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.height_cm
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
    AND s.height_cm > 0
)
SELECT AVG(mh.height_cm) AS avg_height_cm
FROM marvel_heroes mh
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM hero_power hp
  WHERE hp.hero_id = mh.id
    AND hp.power_id NOT IN (SELECT power_id FROM dc_powers WHERE power_id IS NOT NULL)
);

WITH plus_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.element FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
),
bonded AS (
  SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
),
tot AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM plus_atoms),
cnt AS (
  SELECT p.element, COUNT(*) AS c FROM plus_atoms p JOIN bonded b ON b.atom_id = p.atom_id GROUP BY p.element
),
ranked AS (SELECT element, c, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c DESC) rk FROM cnt)
SELECT r.element, ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plus_atoms p WHERE p.element = r.element) / (SELECT total FROM tot), 2) AS pct_of_all_atoms
FROM ranked r WHERE rk = 1

sql:
WITH carbon_mol AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c'
),
atom_cnt AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         count(*) AS n_atoms,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS n_carbon,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS n_chlorine
  FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_cnt AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         count(*) AS n_bonds,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS n_multiple
  FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id
),
cb AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, count(*) AS n_carbon_bonds
  FROM bond b
  WHERE b.bond_id IN (
    SELECT c.bond_id FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'c'
  )
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label,
         COALESCE(ac.n_atoms, 0) AS n_atoms,
         COALESCE(bc.n_bonds, 0) AS n_bonds,
         COALESCE(ac.n_carbon, 0) AS n_carbon,
         COALESCE(ac.n_chlorine, 0) AS n_chlorine,
         COALESCE(cb.n_carbon_bonds, 0) AS n_carbon_bonds,
         COALESCE(bc.n_multiple, 0) AS n_multiple_bonds
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN carbon_mol cm ON cm.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN atom_cnt ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_cnt bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN cb ON cb.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT molecule_id, label, n_atoms, n_bonds, n_carbon, n_chlorine, n_carbon_bonds, n_multiple_bonds,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY n_carbon_bonds DESC, n_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC) AS rank
FROM base
ORDER BY rank;
